sources.title: CrossFit-GS: Out-of-Fold Pose Estimation for COLMAP-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
sources.verification: primary arXiv abstract and full HTML opened this turn
sources.mechanism: Two disjoint owner submaps; refine a frame pose against the frozen opposite submap excluding that frame; discard submaps and reconstruct a final global map under fixed poses.
sources.boundary: Not identical to shared geometry with two cross-fitted SH heads. Nevertheless cross-fitting and avoiding same-frame map self-explanation already have a named near neighbor. No claim of first cross-fitting in3DGS is defensible.

sources.title: Compact Neural Appearance Models for Efficient Gaussian Splatting
sources.verification: primary full HTML and appendix A/B opened this turn
sources.mechanism: Fused comparisons propagate appearance-direction gradients into Gaussian means. Appendix records prior lobe/beta-kernel implementations without this gradient and restores it for comparability.
sources.boundary: Deleting this path is not a new generic decoupling principle. A local causal SH mechanism finding or demonstrated useful method remains untested.

sources.title: GStex: Per-Primitive Texturing of2D Gaussian Splatting for Decoupled Appearance and Geometry Modeling
sources.verification: primary search content and supplement ablation this turn; earlier jury also verified
sources.mechanism: Stops gradients from interpolated textures into primitive positions; supplement contains without-stop-gradient ablation.
sources.boundary: Textured2D primitives differ from standard SH direction gradient, but generic appearance-to-position detachment is established.
